name: vid2-launch
title: vid2-launch — the launch video, made with vid2
summary: A 30-second launch video: two real web captures, three generated stills, synthesized audio and a scene of QA evidence from a first render pass.
techniques: two web captures (a code page and an app)
two-pass render: QA evidence of pass 1 shown in pass 2
goodFor: launch video for a developer tool or web app
showing the product's own output inside the film

needs.note: for media/hero.jpg, still-a.jpg and still-b.jpg; until they exist the renders use --placeholders

edit.what: scenes, copy and which captures and stills appear
the code page that gets captured

steps.run: vid2 capture web --serve code-page --steps code-page.steps.json --size 1280x720 --scale 1.5 --out code
